description: Swings an incoming clock by holding back every other tick

params.text: How far the held-back tick is delayed, from no delay to nine tenths of the gap between the two ticks before it
Attenuverts the swing voltage before it is added to the OFFSET knob, -1 to +1

inputs.text: Adds to the delay set by OFFSET, 10V being the full nine tenths of a tick
The clock being swung; alternate ticks pass straight through and the ticks between them come out late
A trigger here sends a pulse out at once and restarts the alternation, so the tick after it is a delayed one

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse for every incoming tick, half of them on time and half of them late

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
